acceptance: OS keychain/vault injection is origin-scoped, redacts all traces and restricts credential exposure duration.

positive.fixture: sealed file vault with opaque names and 0600 files; Secret Service adapter keeps the secret off the command line; leases work for one origin, a few uses, five minutes

negative.fixture: tampered, swapped and foreign vault files; unreachable keychain stores nothing without an allowed fallback; lease checks like any use; redaction in logs, errors and streams; no credential in artifact store or cache

security_and_source_permissions: Secrets only through short-lived scoped leases; redaction of registered secrets in common encodings.
performance_memory_storage: Lease copies are wiped on return; vault files hold one sealed secret each.
known_limitations: Native macOS and Windows stores are queued as VSF-B16-T08
Durability and lifecycle hardening is VSF-B14-T13
